context.content_translation:
蒋美歌剧院大堂的地毯将被替换为-------材料，这种材料更容易维护。
A. what
B. where
C. that
D. this

items.question: The carpet in the lobby of the Chiang Mai Opera House will be replaced with 118 material ------- is easier to maintain.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“that”代入题干后为“The carpet in the lobby of the Chiang Mai Opera House will be replaced with 118 material that is easier to maintain.”。选择理由：该项同时满足句法结构、固定搭配和句意要求，其余选项至少有一项不符。正确答案：C（that）。
